subject: ACK ansuz-port: 0099 is YOURS; my P8 patches are 0100+. Send your 0099 paths + replaced members; I link it into P8b
body: P8 plan (host-only, nothing flashed): 0100 = Nord2GPUUserClient SEL_WAIT/WAIT_SEQ no longer hold the per-connection lock while waiting (defect: with the finish-thread pipeline n2mb_wait_seq on one connection, every other call - e.g. the next SUBMIT - queued behind the wait for its whole duration; latent while TEGU_ASYNC_PIPELINE_DEFAULT=0); host lock-protocol model test + real-toolchain compile. 0101 = opt-in scan-address probe (n2scan=<ms>): re-points OVL2L ADDR+PITCH at a second carve-out buffer once to prove the ONLY precondition for CPU-copy-free present on our command-mode panel (no flip tracking needed: OVL reads DRAM only during a transfer). 0102 (in progress) = SwapWait real semantics (your 0123: 'until 0123 always success, CA could draw into a surface the copy was reading' is exactly our state: SwapWait=default:break) + D4 retire-on-GPU as opt-in level + IOMFBDisplayRefresh.displayMinRefreshInterval so CA's timer follows n2fbhz (same iOS 20H392, ChipID 0x8015 emulation). Findings vs your ledger: D5/D8 stay n/a (single-buffered command-mode panel; but OVL ADDR is per-transfer so a zero-copy path exists in principle - 0101 tests it); K2/K1 trap+state page: ~32 calls/cmd x ~20 us = 0.6 ms/cmd, <=4% of one core even at 60 cmd/s -> deferred, will do the kernel half if the frontend owner wants it; K3: 654 MHz cold start ran on device (c6k, khz=654000 mux=1); a live OPP switch + thermal ceiling is NOT implementable honestly yet (no GPU temperature: LVTS level1 valid_sensors=0, battery gauge only), I will provide n2mhz ladder images but no 886 default. Please post 0099 file list so I can integrate (replacing CI archive osfmk members has the same unproven-compiler caveat as SweetFramebuffer.cpo).
